# Code Link

> A local terminal companion for Windows and Android, maintained by ZARADEE.

Monitor Windows terminal output, send text and keys, respond to approvals, and receive individual (A) or grouped (B) completion notifications from an Android tablet. USB and Bluetooth transports work locally without a relay server. The current Android release is 1.2.0. The app interface is Chinese.

## Project resources

- [Chinese website](https://zaradee.github.io/code_LINK/): product overview and official downloads.
- [English website](https://zaradee.github.io/code_LINK/en.html): English product overview; the application UI remains Chinese.
- [Repository](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK): source code and issue tracker.
- [Chinese user guide](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/README.md): installation, pairing, reminders and troubleshooting.
- [English user guide](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/README.en.md): supported workflows and limitations.
- [Downloads](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/releases/latest): Windows ZIP and Android APK.
- [Build guide](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/docs/BUILDING.md): development prerequisites and commands.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/docs/implementation.zh-CN.md): architecture and hardware validation.
- [Security](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): planned work, separate from current capabilities.
- [Installation](https://github.com/ZARADEE/code_LINK/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): setup, signing and SHA-256 verification.

## Crawling

Public website pages contain static HTML, canonical and hreflang links, and SoftwareApplication metadata. The sitemap is https://zaradee.github.io/code_LINK/sitemap.xml. This documentation index is a supplemental convention. Project-path robots.txt is a template for the user-site root and does not override root crawling policy.

## Scope

Windows x64 and Android 9+ are the current targets. Existing Windows Terminal mappings follow the active tab. External terminal completion detection requires supported screen markers; structured Codex events are available through clink codex. LAN is implemented but hardware acceptance is pending. iOS, macOS/Linux desktop and WSL are not validated targets. Code uses MIT; supplied artwork and third-party components have separate terms.
